correctness.rationale: For zero-sum cyclic increment d, strict convexity places a maximizing profile at a box-section vertex with at most one non-bound coordinate. The odd-n unit-edge maximizer has one zero increment and can rotate its zero onto the shortened edge, showing rigidity; the even-n vertex multiset is (+1)^(m-1),λ,(-1)^(m-1),-λ. The cyclic Laplacian Green kernel, discrete circle polarization and integrated heights prove the sharp variance (n²-4)/48+λ²/4 for even n, ((n²-1)(n²+3))/(48n²) for odd n. Independent exact rational vertex enumeration checked all n=3..9 at λ=1/3,1/2,1 (21 cases). The infinite-n upper bound relies on the written nonstandard rearrangement argument, not these finite checks.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not alone prove the claimed all-parameter result; proof-specific bounds established in analytic argument.
